show_pot_timer.label: Show pot FATE timer
show_pot_timer.tooltip:
Above the Fates list, show whether a pot FATE (Persistent Pots / Pleading Pots) is up and when the next one is expected.
The estimate assumes the two pots alternate on a fixed cycle and is re-anchored every time one is seen; until then it shows "?".

pot_cycle_minutes.label: Pot FATE cycle (minutes)
pot_cycle_minutes.tooltip:
Cycle used for the estimate. Default 30 minutes.
Measured in game: on the same instance the two pots alternate, the next one appearing about 30:04 after the previous one appeared (each pot about once an hour).
Every time a pot FATE is seen, the measured interval since the previous one is shown in the timer tooltip; adjust this to match.
The two pot alerts below and the illegal mode option "Skip Critical Engagements this many minutes before a pot FATE" use this cycle too.

alert_pot_soon.label: Alert when a pot FATE is about to appear
alert_pot_soon.tooltip:
When the next pot FATE (Persistent Pots / Pleading Pots) is expected soon, print one chat message and play a sound.
The estimate counts from when the previous pot appeared. If no pot has been seen since you entered, or the estimated time passed 5 minutes ago without a pot, the next time is unknown and there is no alert.
Works without "Show pot FATE timer" and without illegal mode. Each alert writes one line to the Dalamud log ([BOCCHI][魔法甕提醒]).

pot_soon_minutes.label: Minutes before
pot_soon_minutes.tooltip: Alert this many minutes before the estimated time; once per appearance.

alert_pot_spawned.label: Alert when a pot FATE appears
alert_pot_spawned.tooltip:
When a pot FATE appears (or, after entering, you first see one that is already running), print one chat message and play a sound.
The same pot alerts at most once every 10 minutes; this resets when you change zones or re-enter the island.
While on, the "Print chat message on (de)spawn", "Alert for all Fates" and the demiatma alerts above skip a pot FATE appearing, so only this alert fires; the pot despawn message is unchanged. While off, pot FATEs go through those alerts as before.

pot_alert_sound.label: Pot alert sound
pot_alert_sound.tooltip: Used by both pot alerts. Sound effect number 1-16, the same sounds as <se.1>-<se.16> in chat.

tooltip.unknown:
No pot FATE seen since entering this island, so there is nothing to estimate from yet.
Once either pot FATE is seen, the other one is estimated from the configured cycle.
tooltip.observed: Seen on the FATE list right now (not an estimate).
tooltip.missed: Expected spawns not seen within 5 minutes:
tooltip.note: This is an estimate: it is re-anchored every time a pot FATE is seen and resets when you enter a new island.
